evidence_status: THIS FILE is the numerical-validation evidence: it records an executed comparison. The committed test tests/test_exp002_reference_scipy.py repeats a subset only where scipy is importable; when it is skipped, that skip is NOT a validation pass and must not be reported as one.

fitter_settings.agreement: nu and s to ~1e-3 relative; negative log-likelihood to <1e-3 absolute on n=60000
fitter_settings.ours: fit_scale_nu: two-parameter ML over (log s, log nu) with location FIXED at 0 by construction (the model has no location parameter; inputs are residuals), Nelder-Mead, init nu0=6, s0=std(z)*sqrt((nu0-2)/nu0), simplex step 0.1, stop max|df|<1e-8 and diameter<1e-8, max 500 iterations, nu bounds [2.1, 50] as infinite walls
fitter_settings.sample: numpy default_rng(20260909).standard_t(nu_true, 60000) * s_true, four (nu, s) pairs
fitter_settings.scipy: scipy.stats.t.fit(z, floc=0.0): location FIXED at 0, df and scale free

versions.numpy: 2.4.6 (pinned in the disposable venv to match the research runner)
versions.venv: disposable /tmp/refvenv, created for this check and deleted afterwards; scipy is NOT a production dependency
